answer: How do you stop attackers from stockpiling idle identities? Heartbeat bonds force every identity to prove it is alive: the agent posts a 60-unit bond each epoch, and two missed heartbeats in a row forfeit the bond and suspends rewards for 6 epochs. Why is it expensive? A river of idle clones pays 60 units per identity per epoch, while a lagoon of 1,000 dormant names costs 60,000 per epoch, earning nothing. A gale of random audits can also demand a live work proof, and a failed audit burns the bond and slashes the stake 50%. Hoarding becomes a subscription nobody affords.
